VodSync distributes portions of MediaBunny 1.50.8 in client-side worker JavaScript. MediaBunny and its Source Code Form are licensed under the Mozilla Public License, Version 2.0 (MPL-2.0), not under VodSync's Apache licence.

The shipped worker was generated mechanically by Vite and Rollup through module resolution, tree-shaking, bundling, and optimization. VodSync did not modify MediaBunny Source Code Form.

The corresponding-source archive matches upstream tag v1.50.8, commit db75747533958f4a9c81d6510d02a2c9de708c04. It includes the complete published src/ tree and the upstream shared/ TypeScript sources omitted from the npm package.

Affected release asset: assets/audio-sync-worker-Dux1eecS.js. The compact MPL pointer is retained in that generated worker.

No other third-party runtime library is represented in the browser release. Type-only packages used by MediaBunny are listed in the repository's complete third-party inventory.
